part1_signal_lifecycle_trace.description: End-to-end trace from raw data to forward resolution

stages.name: Data Quality Validation
stages.details: validate_ohlcv enforces finite numbers, High>=Low, Close in range, strictly positive volume for equities (zero allowed for cash index benchmarks)

stages.name: Completed Candle Extraction (R3)
stages.details: Extracts df.iloc[-2] only if len(df)>=2, strictly excluding forming candle iloc[-1]

stages.name: Long-Only Cash Gate
stages.details: Cash equities suppressed on PUT/SELL; F&O derivatives allowed both directions

stages.name: Score and Category Gates
stages.details: Score >= get_min_score_for_category (70 for cash equity, 80 for derivatives)

stages.name: D20-A Options Quality Gate
stages.details: Enforces breakout > 0 and volume > 0 for options (fail-closed)

stages.name: D20-B Index Session Dedup Gate
stages.details: Max 1 CALL + 1 PUT per index underlying per calendar session

stages.name: Target / SL Level Calculation
stages.details: calculate_directional_levels assigns fixed +4% T1, +8% T2, -3% SL (CALL) / -4% T1, -8% T2, +3% SL (PUT)

stages.name: Presentation Labeling (D26-A/B)
stages.details: Index options labeled SPOT Benchmark Analysis; Futures verified via FuturesContractResolver (FUTURES_ENABLED=False)

stages.name: Persistence and Prediction Snapshot
stages.details: Persists signal to system_signals, generates SHA256 snapshot hash in signal_prediction_snapshots with UNCALIBRATED calibration version

stages.name: Dispatch / Delivery
stages.details: Logs to user_deliveries and dispatches Telegram/Email if enabled

stages.name: Forward Observation Registration
stages.details: Auto-registers record in signal_forward_observations (fail-closed if snapshot missing)

stages.name: Forward Bar Evaluation
stages.details: evaluate_bar checks completed 1m bars for first-touch T1, T2, SL; quarantines same-bar ambiguity (AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR)

stages.name: Outcome Resolution and Expiry
stages.details: First-touch is immutable. Intraday signals expire at 15:30 IST; swing signals expire after 5 trading days

findings.valid_from: Set to exact signal creation/generation timestamp (created_at).
findings.entry_range: Currently not defined as an explicit tolerance band (e.g. +/- 0.25%); assumed to be entry price point reference.
findings.entry_by: No hard expiration deadline for entry execution. Conflated with max_exit_time in notifications.
findings.entry_drift: Drift between signal price and execution LTP is tracked observationally, but not gated at delivery.
findings.stale_invalidation: Signal freshness check (300s) operates at candle level; no secondary quote re-validation before alert dispatch.

findings.target_distance: Fixed +4.0% T1, +8.0% T2, -3.0% SL across all categories.
findings.vs_available_volatility: For Index Options (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY), daily ATR is ~0.7-1.1%. A 4% spot move intraday is 4x-6x ATR, making T1 mathematically improbable intraday. For Cash Equity Swing (5-day horizon), 4% is within 5-day cumulative ATR.
findings.consumed_range: Scanner does not deduct already consumed daily range from remaining expected move.
findings.distance_to_sl: SL is fixed -3.0% (Risk-Reward 1:1.33 for T1, 1:2.67 for T2).

evaluations.audit_note: Sound physical principle, but currently lacks calibrated empirical variance models for NSE universe.
Valid horizon check; already partially enforced by session-close expiry (15:30 IST) for intraday signals.
Diffusion assumption (Brownian motion) not empirically validated against jump processes in Indian market open/close regimes.
Calibrated probability does not yet exist. Enforcing a hard 0.60 gate would filter on uncalibrated heuristic scores.
Contract-level option premium feed is disconnected; cannot calculate option percentage moves on spot data.
Candidate logic is scaffolded in signal_quality_gate.py but intentionally held OFF in production pending forward data.
Arbitrary parameter without statistical empirical distribution of time-to-fill on paper signals.

EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY.validity: EMPIRICALLY SUPPORTED baseline for swing horizon

INDEX_OPTIONS.price_basis: Cash Index Spot LTP (D26-A: labeled SPOT Benchmark Analysis)

part6_probability_calibration_audit.score_vs_prob: Composite score (0-100) is a deterministic heuristic ranking metric, NOT a calibrated probability. The system correctly labels it UNCALIBRATED in prediction snapshots.

part7_time_to_target.remaining_trading_time: Calculated via get_holding_horizon_info() for display/logging; near-close cutoff at 15:15 IST.

part8_expiry_architecture.entry_by: Currently not separate from max_exit_time in notifications
part8_expiry_architecture.position_start: Triggered upon first bar entry confirmation
part8_expiry_architecture.holding_horizon: Same day 15:30 IST for intraday, 5 trading days for swing
part8_expiry_architecture.outcome_observation_end: Closes upon T1/T2/SL touch or holding horizon expiry

part9_pre_delivery_gate_architecture.P0_correctness_defects: NONE in current D26 production code
P1_safe_engineering_enhancements: Expose explicit entry price tolerance band (e.g. entry_range=[entry*0.998, entry*1.002]) in signal metadata
Expose explicit ENTRY_BY timestamp distinct from EXIT_BY in notification payload
P2_observation_telemetry: Record ATR-relative target distance (target_distance / ATR_14) in scan_cycle_metrics
Record remaining_minutes_to_close at signal generation time
P3_statistical_evidence_required: Dynamic ATR-scaled target levels (D20-C activation requires G1/G2/G3 gate clearance)
Hard probability gate at delivery (requires calibrated model on N>=300 resolved observations)

part10_historical_evidence_reconciliatio.d18_diagnosis: Fixed 4% targets on intraday index options cause systematic TIMEOUT
part10_historical_evidence_reconciliatio.d19_d20_d24_d25_experiments: Demonstrated candidate target regimes in isolated tests; correctly kept OFF in production
part10_historical_evidence_reconciliatio.d26_a_b_implementation: Explicitly resolved taxonomy and contract-price parity without altering underlying trading logic

part11_implementation_decision.justification: Under OPB-FINAL-PHASE-GOVERNANCE-001, code changes are permitted ONLY when a reproducible code defect is proven. The current system executes with 100% technical correctness and safety. Gating or altering target levels dynamically without empirical forward observation data would violate the core governance mandate.

part14_final_decision.reason: Engineering and runtime integrity is 100% certified. Forward observation accumulation is actively underway on EC2 (34 signals observing). Forward statistical gates G1/G2/G3 remain open pending empirical market data resolution. Phase E remains strictly blocked.
